segments.name: Kaplan International
segments.evidence: Kaplan International KI operates a diverse portfolio of educational businesses across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, the Asia Pacific region, and North America.

segments.name: Kaplan Higher Education
segments.description: Provides non-academic managed services supporting online programs at higher education institutions, including Purdue University Global.
segments.evidence: KNA provides non-academic managed services such as analytics, technology support, marketing, student advising and admissions support, financial aid services, and curriculum development support for online programs offered at higher education institutions.

segments.name: Kaplan Supplemental Education
segments.description: Provides exam preparation, professional licensure, certification and continuing education offerings to learners from kindergarten through the professional level.
segments.evidence: Training offered to learners includes exam preparation, professional licensure, certification, and continuing education, and degrees predominantly online leading through its industry expertise.

segments.name: Television Broadcasting
segments.description: Owns and operates seven television broadcast stations and provides social media management tools connecting newsrooms with users.
segments.evidence: The Company's television broadcasting segment owns and operates seven television broadcast stations and provides social media management tools designed to connect newsrooms with their users.

segments.name: CSI
segments.description: Provides nursing care and prescription services for patients receiving in-home infusion treatments.
segments.evidence: The largest of these is CSI Pharmacy Holding Company, LLC (CSI), which provides nursing care and prescription services for patients receiving in-home infusion treatments.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Manufactures products for the commercial building industry, electrical and lifting solutions, utility parts and aluminum cladding for industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's manufacturing companies include a multi-product supplier to the commercial building industry, a manufacturer of electrical solutions, a manufacturer of lifting solutions, and a supplier of parts used in electric utilities and industrial systems.

segments.name: Automotive
segments.description: Operates eight automotive dealerships and valet repair services.
segments.evidence: The Company's automotive business comprises eight dealerships and valet repair services.

segments.name: Other Businesses
segments.description: A group of ten operating business units in specialty, retail and media categories, including restaurants, custom framing, marketing solutions and media properties.
segments.evidence: In total, there are ten operating business units that make up this group in three categories: specialty, retail and media.

revenueModel.text: Students, professionals, companies, universities, colleges, schools and school districts pay the Company for educational products and services, and other customers pay for broadcasting, healthcare, manufacturing, automotive and other offerings.
revenueModel.evidence: These relationships include approximately 17,680 companies and approximately 1,510 universities, colleges, schools and school districts, which, along with individual students and professionals, pay for Kaplan's products and services.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company changed its segment presentation into seven reportable segments, breaking CSI out of the healthcare division.
changes.evidence: The Company changed the presentation of its segments in the fourth quarter of 2025 into the following seven reportable segments: Kaplan International, Kaplan Higher Education, Kaplan Supplemental Education, Television Broadcasting, CSI, Manufacturing and Automotive (see Note 19).
